___ew693_notes: EW-693 — Dynamic plugin distribution.
This config enables INDEPENDENT per-plugin versioning so a plugin
release does not require a platform release (FR-7). Today every
@ever-works/*-plugin is at 1.0.0 lockstep; Changesets lets each one
bump on its own changelog entry.
access: restricted (per user directive 2026-06-03) — plugins publish
as PRIVATE packages on npm until the user explicitly authorises
flipping any of them to public. Override per-changeset only with
explicit reviewer + ticket reference.
ignore: internal apps + cross-cutting packages NOT meant for
public/private npm publication. They version with the platform.
@ever-works/agent-plugins is ignored FOR NOW. It is designed to be
publishable on its own merit (a TypeScript reference loader for the
Agent Plugins standard) and its package.json declares MIT per
ADR-018, which diverges from the AGPL-3.0 the rest of the repo uses.
Publishing is therefore a deliberate decision -- license + public vs
restricted -- that has not been taken yet. Ignoring it keeps a stray
changeset from publishing it before that call is made; remove this
entry when it is.
@ever-works/plugin is intentionally NOT in ignore — it ships to npm
as the SDK consumed by 3rd-party plugin authors.
